prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE transparent production SPRITE ATLAS, a cohesive set of numbered stage-selection CELL MEDALLIONS for the Chinese pixel-art game CellDefense.
Input image 1 is the CURRENT UI CONTEXT: redesign only the bland square 1–5 selection buttons into distinctive biological badges. It is not an edit target for a whole screen. Input image 2 is the GAME'S expressive pixel UI lettering and contour style. Input image 3 supplies the warm collagen-rimmed organic cell material.
Create SIX isolated circular-ish medallions in an EXACT THREE-COLUMN, TWO-ROW grid, canvas 1536x1024. Each imaginary cell is 512x512. Keep each medallion inside its own cell with at least 65px transparent margin on every side. Order: TOP row "1", "2", "3"; BOTTOM row "4", "5", then ONE BLANK matching medallion. Exactly six, never extra. No drawn grid, labels or background.
DESIGN: friendly plump living-cell badges. Softly scalloped asymmetric round silhouette, dark plum pixel outline, a chunky pale-cream COLLAGEN MEMBRANE ring enclosing a warm salmon/peach cell body. Two or three small peach cell beads hug the outer rim, integrated rather than floating clutter. Restrained teal/cyan lower membrane accent, less than 10% of each badge; tiny warm-cream highlights. NOT metal coins, machinery, gears, heraldic shields or gems. All five badges have the SAME visual weight, size, material and border language. No special crown on 5 and no distinct reward colors.
NUMBER LETTERING: each center contains exactly ONE immediately readable Arabic digit, in large CUSTOM CHUNKY PIXEL LETTERING, around 55% of badge height. Cream/ivory digit face, 3–4px deep-plum outline, warm coral lower extrusion, a small confident upper-left light cluster. Slightly playful sculpted shapes like the game's title lettering, while 1,2,3,4,5 stay unambiguous. Bold generous strokes and open counters. Do not use a thin plain font. Keep numbers upright and centered. The last medallion has an entirely blank calm peach center, for future 6,7,8... text.
MEDIUM: high-quality hand-painted chunky pixel GAME SPRITES with crisp square-step contours and deliberate limited clusters. Soft organic silhouettes made from pixels. No anti-aliased vector edges, gradients into background, fuzzy glow, blur, realistic wet tissue, noise or photographic shading. Sparse intentional shading only. Strong contrast at small mobile UI size.
TRANSPARENCY: genuinely transparent alpha surrounding every medallion, clean hard sprite silhouettes. No cast shadow onto a backdrop, no glow cloud, checkerboard, solid black or white rectangle.
ONLY text is the five digits "1", "2", "3", "4", "5" in the specified positions. No stars or scores inside the badges; those are separate dynamic UI elements below them. No arrows, locks, weapons, tiny text or title. The result must look like one coherent designed icon family.
